asset.label: Crate Stack
asset.catalog_notes: Two closed timber crates with dark corner posts and plank seams. The 0.35 m top crate is offset one voxel to +X, leaving a ledge on the -X side. The footprint is the base crate; nothing overhangs it.

catalog_entry.label: Crate Stack
catalog_entry.pivot: ground origin at the centre of the base crate; base on z = 0
catalog_entry.behavior: visual_only decoration; studio build-shelf prop (Doodads tab). Its footprint blocks movement where it is placed; nothing else changes in the rules.
